description: Use this when someone wants to buy a used car in Japan, or asks for a used car that fits a budget, a model year, mileage or a manual transmission. To narrow to a specific car, first find its generation with search_vehicles and pass model_id (or series_id for any generation of a series). Returns the cars that dealers list on car-gene.com and that are on sale now: {filters, sort, total, used_cars, next_offset}. Each car has model (the generation it is, with chassis_code and its page url), grade, minor_change_name, total_price_yen (the total payment to drive it away, including the dealer's fees; quote this price, never price_yen alone), price_yen (the body price), first_registration_year and month, mileage_km, inspection_year and month (the vehicle inspection is valid until then), repair_history (true when the car has had frame damage repaired), transmission, shop (the dealer's name, prefecture and city) and the url of its page on car-gene.com, where the photos, details and the inquiry form are. Both prices null means the price is on request. Budget filters use total_price_yen, so cars with the price on request are left out of them. The order is sort only. Cars are cut to fit the response size; when next_offset is not null, call again with offset set to it. Empty used_cars means nothing matched among the cars listed on car-gene.com, not that no such car is for sale elsewhere.

max_total_price_yen.description: Budget: the highest total payment in yen (2,000,000 for 200万円).

max_year.description: Latest year of first registration (年式).

min_total_price_yen.description: The lowest total payment in yen.

min_year.description: Earliest year of first registration (年式).

model_id.description: Generation (model) id, a UUID from search_vehicles. Takes precedence over series_id when both are given.

no_repair_history.description: true to leave out cars with repair history (修復歴あり).

offset.description: Where to start in the list; pass next_offset from the previous response. Omit to start from the beginning.

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture where the dealer is, in Japanese, such as 埼玉県, 東京都 or 北海道.

series_id.description: Series id, a UUID from search_vehicles, for cars of any generation of the series.

sort.description: new (latest listed first), price_asc, price_desc (by total payment), year_asc, year_desc, mileage_asc.

transmission.description: mt (manual, MT), at (automatic, AT), cvt, or other.

name: search_used_cars
title: Search used cars for sale in Japan
